items.title: Pandora appoints new CEO for Southern Europe
items.summary: Pandora is restructuring its organization in Europe. The Danish jewelry chain has appointed Eric Lejeune as managing director for France, Spain, and Portugal. He is tasked with driving the brand’s continued growth in those markets.

items.title: Carrefour brings AI shopping assistant to Belgium
items.summary: Carrefour Belgium customers can now do their grocery shopping directly through ChatGPT. The retailer is following in the footsteps of Carrefour France, which launched this European first earlier this year in collaboration with Mealz.ai.

items.title: Grupo Mateus Reports 12.2% Net-Revenue Growth In Q2 2026
items.summary: Brazilian food retailer Grupo Mateus reported net revenue of R$ 9.9 billion (€1.6 billion) for Q2 2026, up 12.2% year on year.

items.title: Nestlé Uses Coffee By-Product To Generate Energy At UK Site
items.summary: Nestlé UK is using a by-product of its coffee production process as biomass fuel to supply its Tutbury site with energy.

items.title: Death Of The Consumer Conglomerate? Unilever Bets Less Is More
items.summary: Unilever is shedding food assets to focus on beauty, personal care and home products, aiming to close its valuation gap and lift returns.

items.title: Lego manages to build new customer base as well as record revenue
items.summary: Lego once again gained significant market share in the first half of 2026. Both children and adults bought more of the building sets, while the Danish toy maker was able to attract new consumers through the World Cup and Formula 1.

items.title: Unhidden founder on why adaptive fashion is retail’s overlooked growth opportunity

items.title: Allied Blenders strikes local production agreement for Malaysia
items.summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers has struck an local production agreement, allowing it to produce Officer’s Choice Blue whisky in Malaysia.

items.title: Bolia continues European expansion with entry into the British market
items.summary: The Danish design brand Bolia is launching on the British market with the opening of two flagship stores in prime locations in London. At the same time, the retailer is unveiling a new store concept, developed in collaboration with marketing expert Martin Lindstrøm.

items.title: M&S expands European online fulfilment through Zalando’s ZEOS
items.summary: Marks & Spencer (M&S) has expanded its partnership with Zalando’s B2B logistics and fulfilment business, ZEOS, as it aims to bolster its direct-to-consumer arm.

items.title: Magnum welcomes pruning of Ben & Jerry’s lawsuit
items.summary: The Magnum Ice Cream Company has welcomed a US court decision narrowing a lawsuit brought by former Ben & Jerry’s independent directors. The post Magnum welcomes pruning of Ben & Jerry’s lawsuit appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: James Watt launches non-alc brand Fool’s Fix
items.summary: The former BrewDog co-founder and CEO has launched a non-alcoholic drinks brand called Fool's Fix under his beer venture Second Best.

items.title: Marks & Spencer expands to 22 European markets via Zalando
items.summary: Marks & Spencer (M&S) has expanded its partnership with Zalando: through the German fashion platform, the British retailer can now cost-effectively serve consumers in 22 European markets.

items.title: Crocs to launch store at Northern Ireland retail park
items.summary: Plans have been unveiled to launch a Crocs outlet at Northern Ireland shopping destination The Boulevard - Banbridge.

items.title: Lil Luv Dog launches in Selfridges
items.summary: Lil Luv Dog has launched its liquid shampoo and leave-in conditioning mist exclusively at Selfridges, marking its debut in the UK market.

items.summary: Natural skincare firm Aroma-Zone has unveiled a new pop-up experience at Westfield White City, designed to introduce consumers to the brand and its range of formulas. With the theme ‘France’s Favourite Serums. Discover Yours’, visitors will receive beauty advice, product…

items.title: Charter Opens 22 Supermarkets In Spain Since February
items.summary: Charter opened 22 new stores during the first half of its 2026 financial year, hitting nearly 60% of its total annual target.

items.title: Mondelēz brings UK protein bar Grenade to the US
items.summary: The snacking giant behind Clif and Perfect Bar is doubling down on its domestic bar portfolio to leverage growing consumer demand for protein.

items.title: Nordzucker Plans To End Sugar Production At Denmark's Nakskov Factory
Special Olympics GB athletes to test accessibility of UK deposit return scheme
items.summary: Special Olympics GB athletes are help test the accessibility of the UK’s future Deposit Return Scheme (DRS) during the National Summer Games in Birmingham from 27 to 30 August.

Iceland Foods Takes Frozen Favourites Back To South Korea
items.summary: Iceland Foods is expanding its presence in South Korea through a new partnership with Lotte Mart with dedicated concessions in 45 stores.

items.title: Plant-based advocates sue US government over dietary guidelines
items.summary: A US physicians’ group advocating for plant-based diets has sued the country's government over the new dietary guideline recommendations. The post Plant-based advocates sue US government over dietary guidelines appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Bacardi launches RTD cocktail under Teeling
items.summary: Bacardi-owned Teeling Whiskey Company is entering the ready-to-drink category with its first canned cocktail called Phoenix Twist.

items.title: Albert Heijn Launches New Range To Support Healthier Eating Among Children
items.summary: Dutch retailer Albert Heijn has launched a new range, AH Hamsterchef, as it seeks to help families with children eat more healthily.

items.title: Butterball reaches settlement in turkey pricing case
items.summary: Butterball has agreed to a $34m settlement to resolve allegations the US poultry producer conspired to inflate turkey prices. The post Butterball reaches settlement in turkey pricing case appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Strait of Hormuz faces renewed pressure as US threatens ‘economic D-Day’
items.summary: The Strait of Hormuz is facing renewed uncertainty as the US prepares a major new package of sanctions against Iran.

items.summary: Barbour, ASOS and British artist Jimmy Turrell have teamed up to reimagine Barbour’s Bedale Jacket using contemporary fashion and art. The Barbour Re-loved x ASOS: Jimmy Turrell Edition will be available exclusively on ASOS. The range comprises of ten jackets, designed to be…

items.title: Sazerac expands whiskey range on sale in India
items.summary: Sazerac has added to its portfolio in India with the launch of two blended American whiskey brands in the country.

items.title: Kimberly-Clark Names Suzana Blades As Senior Vice President And General Counsel
items.summary: Consumer goods firm Kimberly-Clark has appointed Suzana Blades as its new senior vice president and general counsel, effective 1 September.

items.title: NewPrinces enters energy drinks
items.summary: Italian food-and-drinks group NewPrinces is dipping its toe into the energy market, with the launch of a drinks brand called Spartan.

items.title: Cyclospora outbreak is crimping produce sales, data shows
items.summary: More than 6.5 million households stopped buying salad mixes and kits during the month that ended July 26, according to Numerator.

items.title: Saint James enters yerba mate with first new product extension
items.summary: The Gen Z-focused brand is broadening its reach to tap into a demand for natural caffeine.

items.title: Kardashian’s Skims brings in design chief from Supreme
items.summary: Skims continues to build its professional team with the appointment of two new executives. Kim Kardashian’s lingerie and fashion brand has promoted Kim Schraub to chief brand officer and brought on Erin Magee, formerly of streetwear brand Supreme, as chief design officer.

items.title: Shrinkflation still prevalent in supermarkets
items.summary: "Shrinkflation" is less common than it was a few years ago, but manufacturers continue to reduce package sizes without lowering prices accordingly. The Dutch Consumers' Association found dozens of examples again last year and is calling on policymakers to implement stricter…

items.title: Walmart Rolls Out Tap To Pay Service, Expands Scintilla Platform
items.summary: Walmart has announced a major double rollout set to enhance both backend supplier collaboration and frontend checkout convenience.
